# Design engineering · 设计工程

The agent's design medium is code. Component libraries and primitives by stack, animation and graphics libraries, token tooling, and the pipeline that turns HTML, SVG and markup into images, PDFs and slides. Verify APIs against the installed version.

101 resources, plus 13 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `python3 "$S/catalog.py" find` (`S` = `skills/design-studio/scripts`) searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Component libraries and headless primitives · 组件库与无头原语

Use the host project's library. When choosing, prefer accessible primitives and a real theme API.

## Animated and marketing component kits · 动效组件与营销套件

Technique references. A page assembled from these looks like every other; use one signature moment and restyle it.

## Open design tools · 开放设计工具

Scriptable or open tools that complement a code-first workflow.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Penpot](https://penpot.app) | Open-source design tool built on SVG and CSS concepts, with tokens and an MCP server | Self-hostable design source of truth; agents connect through its official MCP server | A | tool | static | free · MPL-2.0 |  |
| [Inkscape](https://inkscape.org) | Mature open-source SVG editor with a command line for batch export | Batch-export SVG to PNG or PDF from the command line (inkscape --export-type=png file.svg) | A | tool | static | free · GPL |  |
| [Blender](https://www.blender.org) | Open-source 3D suite, scriptable in Python | Scripted renders of product or icon scenes | A | tool | static | free · GPL |  |
| [Figma](https://www.figma.com) | The design tool of record for most product teams: components, variables (tokens and modes), Dev Mode and a REST API | Read the team's variables and components before designing; agents pull file data through the REST API or the Figma MCP server | A | tool | static | freemium · login | [REST API](https://developers.figma.com/docs/rest-api/); [Guide to variables](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/15339657135383-Guide-to-variables-in-Figma) |
| [pen.dev (formerly Pencil)](https://www.pen.dev) | Agent-native design canvas (desktop and IDE) whose .pen files are an open format kept in the repo, with MCP, WebMCP and CLI access | Keep .pen files next to the code so agents and people edit the same design; review agent edits like code | A | tool | static | free · login | [Docs (.pen format, CLI, design and code)](https://docs.pen.dev) |
| [Paper](https://paper.design) | Design tool whose canvas is built on HTML and CSS, with an MCP server through which agents read and write frames | Use when designs should hand off as CSS; connect the MCP server so an agent can lay out frames or turn a selected frame into code | A | tool | static | freemium · login | [MCP server](https://paper.design/docs/mcp) |
| [MasterGo (莫高设计) (zh)](https://mastergo.com) | Leading domestic Figma-class design tool (from the Lanhu team) with prototyping, a developer mode, AI features and an official MCP server | Expect Chinese product teams to deliver files here; read components and styles in developer mode, and connect MasterGo Magic MCP for agents | A | tool | static | freemium · login | [MasterGo Magic MCP (GitHub)](https://github.com/mastergo-design/mastergo-magic-mcp) |
| [Pixso (zh)](https://pixso.cn) | Domestic collaborative UI design and prototyping tool with in-canvas AI generation and a Pixso MCP that connects designs to code | Check which domestic tool the client team uses before handoff; connect Pixso MCP when the source files live here | A | tool | static | freemium · login |  |
| [Storybook](https://storybook.js.org) | The standard workshop for building, documenting and testing UI components in isolation, with visual, interaction and accessibility tests | If the project has a Storybook, render new components as stories in every state before building screens; agents read storybook.js.org/llms.txt | A | tool | static | free · MIT | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://storybook.js.org/llms.txt) |
